name: Mimasaka Hajime
source: The protagonist of the story who is a second-year student at Asayake Academy. He lives in a huge house together with his secretary [url=/c14011]Mariko[/url]. His parents died when he was young and as a result, had to take over their business. Aside from his parents' business he manages multiple IT companies, which has made him amass a huge amount of money. He is popular with the girls due to his friendly and kind personality (which is, however, just an act) and controls the teachers and school's board with money.
